# WO-2026-08-09-09 — Rule 37's companion line

## What R4 established, and why this order is narrow

`WO-B15-R4` delivered rule 37's **rounding** half and **correctly refused** the rest: the rulebook's
three verbs (`set_product`, `set_quantity`, `ask`) can only re-resolve or re-quantify a line that
already exists, and inventing a fourth verb is a design decision above a Work Order. **That refusal
was right and is not being overturned.**

**What IS authorised is narrower than the thing it refused.** Warwick, on the method:

> *"close that one with the **narrow deterministic companion-line seam** you already described.
> Anything else gets handled from actual evidence, **not by inventing a general fourth model verb in
> anticipation**."*

**The key fact that makes this deterministic rather than a judgement:** the companion product is
**already decided by rule 24** — an active `map` row resolving `'Sure female'` to
`Sure Women Anti-Perspirant Deodorant (white variant)`. **No model chooses it.** The rulebook is not
being given the power to put arbitrary products in a basket; it is being given the power to emit a
line for a product **another rule has already mapped**.

## ⛔ The bound that defines this order

> **A companion line may ONLY carry a product that an active `map` rule already resolves.**

If a reply names anything else — a product from the catalogue, a plausible-sounding name, a product
mapped for a different household — **refuse it and leave the line alone.** That refusal is the
feature. Build it so the refusal is the default and the permission is the special case, not the
reverse.

## Acceptance criteria

- **AC1 — The companion line exists.** A Sure line requesting an odd quantity plans as: the male line
  at the rounded-up-to-even quantity **minus one**, plus a **separate line** for the female variant
  at quantity 1 — i.e. the live rule's own worked example, **3 male → 2 male + 1 female = 4** (rule
  37: *"Mum 3 male -> add 1 female = 4"*). **If you read the arithmetic differently, say so in your
  return and implement what the rule text says.**
- **AC2 — Only a mapped product can be a companion.** Executed proof in **both** directions: rule 24's
  mapped product is accepted; an unmapped product, a catalogue-only product and a foreign-household
  mapped product are each **refused**, with the line left untouched and the refusal recorded.
- **AC3 — No price, anywhere.** Drive AC1 from a catalogue with **no price field**. R4's and R3's
  archival control must still stand and still fire — **re-mutation-test it.** If this work forces you
  to weaken it, **STOP and report.**
- **AC4 — Attribution.** The companion line names **rule 37** as its cause and **rule 24** as the
  source of the product, in the note a person reads. Warwick must be able to ask *"why is there a
  women's deodorant in my trolley"* and get an answer from the shop itself.
- **AC5 — The existing safety envelope is not widened elsewhere.** `set_product` still draws only
  from candidates the line offered; the companion path must not become a general escape from that.
  Assert it against your own diff.
- **AC6 — Counts, all eight suites**, before and after. Assert the count, never the exit code.
  `skill` must still show exactly its **7** pre-existing environment failures.

## Required evidence

- The AC1 case executed and pasted — odd quantity in, two lines out, from a price-free catalogue.
- AC2's refusals executed and pasted, all three.
- The AC3 re-mutation, both directions, with a byte-identical restore check. **Mutate a copy or
  restore in a `finally`.**
- All eight suite counts before and after; `node services/asdair/handoff/mutation-proof.js` → `9/9`.
- `bash scripts/secret-scan.sh --surface services/asdair/skill/rulebook.js services/asdair/skill/rulebook.test.js services/asdair/skill/README.md` → report exit code AND coverage. Exit 2 is NOT SCANNED, never a pass

## Inputs supplied

- `Deliverables/2026-08-09-live-rule-corpus-and-value-rule-identification.md` — the live corpus.
  **Authoritative. Query no database.**
- `Deliverables/2026-08-09-return-B15-R4-restore-rule-37.md` — what R4 built, and its reasoning for
  refusing the fourth verb. **Read it; you are extending its work, not redoing it.**

## A SECOND EVIDENCED CONSUMER — shape for it, do NOT implement it

Larry checked all 40 active rules for this shape. **Exactly two need it**, and the second is real:

> **Rule 39** — *"Mum '3 Mince Hotpot' = ASDA hotpot ready meals: **2 beef + 1 chicken**. NOT in
> regulars — **missed this week** because it needs a search and the agent silently dropped it."*

One list line → **two different products at different quantities**. It is evidence, not speculation —
its own text records a real shop where it failed.

**Do NOT implement rule 39.** But do not build a seam that is accidentally Sure-shaped either: if
your design can only ever emit *one* companion of *one* product, say so in your return so Larry knows
what it will cost later. **Shape for it; implement rule 37 only.** ⛔ **No general mechanism, no
registry, no rule-expression language** — the regrowth cap applies at full force.

## Explicitly out of scope — report, never fix

- **Rule 39** — evidenced, named, and not yours.
- Rules 31 and 36 — archived; do not restore them or weaken the control that keeps them out.
- The remembered-choice mechanism and migration 018 — a different lane is building it **in a
  different worktree right now**. Do not anticipate it, and touch nothing under
  `services/asdair/pipeline/**` or `services/asdair/db/**`.
- `planner.js` and its `rankAlternatives` price-proximity ordering — recorded, parked.
- Any live database connection.

## Sequencing

1. **READ-BACK first** — outcome, plan, what this order fails to settle, what looks wrong. **Do NOT
   hold for my acceptance**; state it at the top of your return and continue. `REFUSE` only if
   genuinely unsafe or impossible.
2. Read R4's return and the live corpus before designing.
3. AC2's bound **first** — build the refusal, then the permission. It is easier to prove a narrow
   thing was widened than to prove a wide thing was narrowed.
4. AC1, then AC3's re-mutation, then the eight-suite sweep.
5. Commit onto `b15-3/rule37-companion`. **Commit only. NO push. NO PR. Do not touch `main`. Do not
   merge.**
6. Write your return to `Deliverables/2026-08-09-return-B15-R5-rule37-companion-line.md` — **in your
   `file_surface`** — and commit it.

**You are the only writer in `C:/Fusion247PKA-r37`.** A second lane is live in a different worktree;
if you see a commit you did not make, stop and report it.

**The ceiling:** no real shop has run. **This order completes nothing.**
